tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for joining. First, can you share a volunteer task you did at a sports event (e.g., guiding spectators, managing equipment) and what motivated you to take it?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢您的参与。首先，请分享一项您在体育赛事中承担的志愿服务工作（例如引导观众、管理器材），并说明选择这项工作的动机。
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. Many events need volunteers to work long hours. Do you think flexible scheduling for volunteers is important? Why or why not?
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。许多赛事需要志愿者长时间服务。您认为弹性排班对志愿者而言是否重要？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. When completing volunteer work, some people prefer to work alone, while others like to finish tasks through team collaboration. Which do you prefer and why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：很有意思。完成志愿服务时，有人倾向于独立工作，有人则更喜欢团队协作。您更青睐哪种方式？原因是什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. Lastly, When working with other volunteers, conflicts might arise. How would you resolve a disagreement with other volunteers?
tasks.analysis: 中文：很好的观点。最后，当与其他志愿者共事时，可能会产生矛盾。若与其他志愿者出现意见分歧，您会如何化解？
tasks.title: Interview
